messages:
Anya: heads-up: perf regression on mixed-quant path after yesterday's runtime build.  p95 generation latency up ~18% for fp8->int8 fallback on sm86 boxes.
Sam: ugh. observed on canary?
Anya: yeah, small canary traffic. turned on extra tracing and saw more GEMM stalls when prober picks CUTLASS path vs triton.
Diego: any repro script? can we run local microbench to compare kernels?
Anya: repro script attached in thread (run on a sm86 GPU):
```bash
# repro
python perf_repro.py --model llama-2-13b --dtype fp8 --seq 512 --batch 8 --warm 50 --iters 200
```
Kalpana: I ran it on a sm86 VM. baseline (pre-buildflag) mean token/sec 420, after-change 340.
Ben: that is huge. is KV cache behavior different? evictions or alignment issues?
Anya: traced KV cache traffic with net-trace. noticed extra memcpy calls right before GEMM when CUTLASS chosen. feels like layout mismatch + prefetch path not firing.
Sam: can you paste the profiler snippet?
Anya: profiler summary (filtered):
```
[PROF] conv_gemm_cutlass: kernel_time 2.8ms memcpy_before 0.9ms memcpy_after 0.2ms
[PROF] triton_gemm: kernel_time 2.1ms memcopy 0.05ms
[KV] kvcache_hits: 98.3% but kvcache_alignment_misses: 12.6%
```
Diego: alignment_misses are telling. CUTLASS route expects packed P4 layout, runtime is sending P4-unpacked for some sequences. prober's calibration probably flipped kernel choice incorrectly for sm86 when seq<768.
Kalpana: build flags we flipped were `-DUSE_CUTLASS_P4_OPT=ON -DARCH_PROBER_STRICT=0` last night.
Ben: hey infra-bot, any deploys touching triton/cutlass selection config in the last 24h?
infra-bot: deploy 2026-03-17T23:12:14 by deploy-ci: feature/quant-routing toggles merged.
Sam: ok that matches. quick mitigation: force triton for sm86 until we fix prober calibration. Can we patch prober to check kv alignment before selecting cutlass?
Diego: yes. small change: after arch-probe, run a fast layout-check on a single batch and if alignment_miss_rate>5% prefer triton. cheap and stable.
Anya: created a canary branch and a quick script `check_kv_alignment()` that hooks into prober. pushed to `hotfix/kv-align-guard`.
Kalpana: rolling hotfix to canary now. monitoring.
(10m later) Kalpana: canary back: p95 reduced to baseline+2%. logs show we avoided cutlass path on bad alignment cases.
Sam: nice. next steps: 1) proper root cause test in prober calibration harness, 2) add a compile-time CUTLASS packing flag toggle for safety, 3) write an e2e regression eval for mixed-quant perf.
Ben: add a console alert when kvcache_alignment_misses spikes >10% for any model-route, so SRE gets notified.
Diego: also note we should upstream a test into triton compatibility matrix: if CUTLASS path needs specific strides/layout, we must fail open in prober.
Anya: agreed. I'll open a PR with tests and the prober guard.
Sam: thanks folks. great catch. :thumbsup:
Ben: filing follow-ups: CI job to run `perf_repro.py` on every quant-related build, create rollback playbook for kernel toggles.
Anya: linking logs and diffs: https://redwood.internal/logs/1912345678 and PR: https://redwood.internal/pr/4242
Kalpana: closing canary after stable run. will keep monitoring for 24h. :white_check_mark:
Diego: note for postmortem: add a short blurb about buildflag impacts on layout assumptions and defaulting prober to conservative selection.
Anya: will add to eng-runtime notes.
